Kagoshima Wagyu · Steak & Nikuzushi

Kagoshima Wagyu, served two ways: steak and wagyu sushi.

We serve only Japanese Black wagyu raised in Kagoshima Prefecture: steaks cooked one piece at a time, and wagyu sushi such as Uniku, NIKURA and Wagyu Rossini. Two minutes on foot from Tenmonkan-dori tram stop.

Wagyu
Our way

One breed, two ways to eat it.

Only Kagoshima-raised Japanese Black

Every cut of beef, for steak and for sushi, is Japanese Black wagyu from Kagoshima Prefecture. Sirloin, round, fillet and chateaubriand each have their own texture and flavour.

Cooked one piece at a time

Sirloin, round, fillet, chateaubriand. Each cut is cooked according to its thickness and fat, and checked at the cut face before it leaves the kitchen.

Wagyu as sushi

Uniku (wagyu with sea urchin), NIKURA (wagyu with salmon roe) and Wagyu Rossini (wagyu, foie gras and truffle). One piece at a time, for flavours that grilling does not give.

Questions

Before you come.

What beef do you use?

Only Japanese Black wagyu raised in Kagoshima Prefecture. We serve it as steak (sirloin, round, fillet, chateaubriand) and as sushi.

How much are the courses?

Dinner courses are ¥6,000, ¥8,000, ¥11,000 and ¥15,000 per person, tax included, food only. Two hours of free-flow drinks can be added for ¥2,000. Lunch starts at ¥1,800.

Can I book a course for one?

Yes. Every course can be booked for a single guest, and we have counter seats.

Do I need a reservation?

Walk-ins are seated when a table is free. For courses we recommend booking by the day before. For today, calling 099-248-7400 is quickest.

Can you help with a birthday or anniversary?

Table decoration and a dessert plate with your message are complimentary. A bouquet is ¥3,500. Tell us when you book.

Do you accept UnionPay, Alipay or WeChat Pay?

Yes. We also accept VISA, Mastercard, JCB, AMEX, Diners and Discover, and Japanese e-money and QR payments.

Is there a menu in other languages?

Yes. The menu is printed in Japanese, English and Chinese.

Can you accommodate allergies or ingredients I avoid?

Tell us when you book and we will do what we can. Please note that some dishes use raw beef and raw horse meat.

Is there a cancellation fee?

For course bookings, 50% the day before and 100% on the day. For table-only bookings, ¥4,000 per person on the day.
